title: Rational-point normalization of the comparison Chern family
statement: For A,N,c,b,d as in SpP1NormalizedDecompositions [def-sp-p1-proetale-trace-system], the family c satisfies SpP1RationalPointChern: over every algebraically closed field on which N is invertible, every rational point section of P1 has the same scalar Kummer class as c, with its invertible Cartier ideal and the specified Kummer sign.

source.place: Proof paragraph 2: the rational-point divisor has the O(1) Kummer class

proof.text: P1 is a smooth proper connected geometric curve. A point section of this smooth relative curve has invertible ideal.
The divisor line of a rational point has degree one. The standard monomial calculation gives chi(O(d))=d+1 for d=0,1, and hence deg(O(1))=1.

For a smooth proper connected geometric curve, the Kummer degree coordinate on H2 of roots of unity is bijective. Its value on the boundary of a line bundle is its degree modulo N, by the Kummer sequence, Brauer vanishing and divisibility of degree-zero Picard classes. Thus the two boundaries agree.
Apply the scalar root map and use the normalized Chern specification to obtain the exact displayed rational-point condition.
